title: Competitive Programming Meeting with Alumni Pavel Vai — February 2025
excerpt: An insightful competitive programming session and mentorship meetup with Southeast University alumnus Pavel Vai, Senior Software Engineer at Cefalo Bangladesh Ltd., held in February 2025.
author: Fazley Rabbi

body:
## Learning from an Experienced Senior

In **February 2025**, our competitive programming community at Southeast University had the privilege of hosting an interactive meetup with distinguished alumnus **Pavel Vai**, currently working as a **Senior Software Engineer at Cefalo Bangladesh Ltd.**

## Insights on Competitive Programming and Industry Careers

During the meeting, Pavel Vai shared valuable advice on mastering competitive programming, building strong problem-solving habits, and bridging the gap between algorithmic contests and real-world software engineering careers. The discussion covered topics such as:

- **Effective Practice Strategies:** How to approach hard problems methodically and analyze post-contest solutions.
- **Industry Perspective:** How strong problem-solving skills prepare software engineers for top tech companies.
- **Career Mentorship:** Guidance on technical interviews, continuous learning, and navigating software development roles.

## Inspiring the Community

Meeting with successful alumni who walked the same campus corridors and pursued competitive programming is always inspiring. It gave all of us renewed drive to continue practicing diligently and aim high in our academic, contest, and professional journeys.

These photographs capture memorable moments from the meetup in front of the campus cafeteria and hallway alongside fellow programmers and Pavel Vai.
